content_sections.heading: JKSSB Class-IV Vacancy 2026 – Post Details
content_sections.text: JKSSB has advertised a total of 2863 posts under this notification, comprising Class-IV (MTS) and Sanitation Worker posts distributed across UT Cadre, Divisional Cadre, and District Cadre. The official notification also lists the vacancies notified may increase or decrease before the selection process concludes. Department-wise and item-number-wise post distribution (e.g. Public Works R&B, Animal/Sheep Husbandry, Agriculture Production and others) is given in Annexure-A of the official notification, which candidates should refer to for the exact item number relevant to their preferred cadre and department.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Class-IV Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for JKSSB Class-IV (MTS) & Sanitation Worker Recruitment 2026 must satisfy the domicile, qualification, and age conditions below, all assessed as on the cut-off date of 03.11.2026 (or 01.01.2026 for age). Candidates must be Domicile holders of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir with a valid Domicile Certificate issued on or before the cut-off date. Candidates must possess the prescribed educational qualification for the post/cadre applied for, verified at the Document Verification stage. Candidates possessing qualification other than what is prescribed will not be eligible, and their candidature is liable to be summarily rejected at any stage of the selection process.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Class-IV Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age of candidates is reckoned as on 01.01.2026. Ex-Servicemen may deduct their period of Armed Forces service from actual age; if the resultant age doesn't exceed the post's maximum limit by more than 3 years, they are deemed to satisfy the age condition. An additional 5-year relaxation in upper age limit is available to candidates claiming the casual-worker additional weightage benefit under the J&K Appointment to Class IV (Special Recruitment) Rules, 2020. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Class-IV Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee is payable only through online mode (Net Banking, Credit Card, or Debit Card). Applications submitted without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected, and the fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Class-IV Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for both Class-IV (MTS) and Sanitation Worker posts will be placed in Pay Level SL1, carrying a pay scale of ₹14,800 – ₹47,100, as per Annexure-D of the notification.

content_sections.heading: JKSSB Class-IV Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for JKSSB Class-IV (MTS) & Sanitation Worker Recruitment 2026 will be based on an Objective Type Written Test followed by Document Verification, with the overall merit determined using written test marks plus additional weightage points. Written examination will consist of Objective Type, Multiple Choice Questions set in English only. Negative marking applies: one-fourth of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for each wrong answer. Total marks are distributed between the written test and additional weightage points, and the split differs by cadre as shown below. Cadre and Department allocation for successful candidates will be done on a merit-cum-preference basis, and once notified, allocation decisions are final and binding. Original and self-attested photocopies of the online application form and all certificates. Domicile Certificate (valid as on the cut-off date). Educational qualification certificates. Category/Reservation certificate in the prescribed format, if applicable. Two recent passport-size colour photographs (not older than 6 months) and a valid photo ID proof. Certificates supporting any weightage claim (no-government-family-member, widow/divorced/orphan status, or casual-worker status), where applicable.

JKSSB Class-IV Apply Online link will be activated on the official website from 05.10.2026 to 03.11.2026.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in JKSSB Class-IV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2863 posts have been advertised, comprising 105 UT Cadre posts, 1990 Divisional Cadre posts (Jammu and Kashmir combined), and 768 District Cadre posts across 20 districts.

faq.question: Q2. What is JKSSB Class-IV (MTS) & Sanitation Worker Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Jammu and Kashmir Services Selection Board, under Advertisement Notification No. 09 of 2026 dated 01.09.2026, to fill 2863 Class-IV (MTS) and Sanitation Worker posts across UT, Divisional, and District cadres in J&K.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for JKSSB Class-IV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 03.11.2026, which is also the cut-off date for age, qualification, and category certificates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for JKSSB Class-IV posts?
faq.answer: For Class-IV (MTS) posts, the minimum qualification is Matriculation and the maximum is 10+2. For Sanitation Worker posts, the minimum qualification is 8th Pass and the maximum is 10+2.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for JKSSB Class-IV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 01.01.2026, the maximum age limit is 40 years for Open Merit candidates, 43 years for SC/ST-1/ST-2/RBA/ALC-IB/EWS/OBC candidates, and 42 years for PwBD candidates, with additional relaxations for Ex-Servicemen and casual-worker weightage claimants.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for JKSSB Class-IV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹600 for General category candidates and ₹500 for SC, ST-1, ST-2, EWS, and PwBD category candidates, payable only through online mode.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for JKSSB Class-IV (MTS) & Sanitation Worker Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official JKSSB website (www.jkssb.nic.in) between 05.10.2026 and 03.11.2026 by filling the application form, uploading photograph/signature, and paying the fee online.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for JKSSB Class-IV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on an Objective Type Written Test (with negative marking) combined with additional weightage marks, followed by Document Verification for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for JKSSB Class-IV (MTS) posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in Pay Level SL1, carrying a pay scale of ₹14,800 – ₹47,100.

faq.question: Q10. Is domicile of Jammu & Kashmir mandatory for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must be Domicile holders of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir and must possess a valid Domicile Certificate on or before the cut-off date of 03.11.2026.
